text: The system shall assign every new motor claim a triage band within 2 minutes of first notice of loss.
The claims handler shall contact the customer within 4 working hours of a claim in the urgent band.
The system shall log each triage band change with the person, the time, the old band and the new band.
The claims handler shall contact the policyholder within 1 working day of a claim in the urgent band.
The team leader shall approve any move of a claim out of the urgent band.
The system shall move a claim out of the urgent band automatically when the repair estimate is under 1,000.
The system shall assign a fraud score to every new motor claim.
